inventory_files.note: The canonical main file already contains the complete 250-card report inventory. The split files 256_274, 275_298 and promulgation_2_11 are archival snapshots/alternate splits and overlap the canonical file; they are intentionally not loaded.

loader_requirement: Load the canonical main inventory only, validate unique card IDs, and preserve each card's search_eligible=false/review_state/limitations. Do not load archived split snapshots because their records overlap the canonical file. Any future split must first be reconciled and deduplicated against the canonical inventory.
known_gaps: The canonical main inventory is larger than the GitHub Contents API readable-size limit; the report/test runner reads it in the repository checkout.
The split files 256_274, 275_298 and promulgation_2_11 are archived review snapshots, not manifest inputs, because they overlap the canonical inventory and may contain divergent duplicates.
Some supplemental split-card content may not be represented in the canonical inventory; reconcile and selectively merge any unique improvements before re-enabling those files.
Supplemental cards have inferred Gazette page pinpoints, not visually verified.
Some penalty summaries and implementing-decision mappings are secondary-source cross-checks only.
Currentness, full amendments, reuse rights and Egyptian-lawyer review remain incomplete.
Promulgation Articles 2–11 page pinpoints are not visually verified.
